common.disclaimer: Sukhi helps you follow a routine you have agreed on. It is not a medical service, does not diagnose, and does not monitor emergencies. In an emergency call 112.

landing.heroTitle: Stay with the plan you and your doctor agreed on.
landing.heroBody: Sukhi reminds you gently, listens in your language, and celebrates every day you show up — including the day you start again.
landing.heroNote: Works in your phone's browser and on WhatsApp. Nothing to install.
landing.demoHint: Tap “I did it” to record today's walk.
landing.howIntro: Four small steps, repeated each day. That's the whole idea.
landing.step1Body: Type it in, or photograph what your care team gave you. You check every line before anything is scheduled.
landing.step2Body: At the times you choose, in the app or on WhatsApp — never during your quiet hours.
landing.step3Body: Done, later, skipped or not feeling well. Every honest answer counts. Add a photo if you like.
landing.step4Body: Weekly consistency, milestones, and a welcome-back bonus after a break.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to keep going, nothing you don't
landing.f1Body: Ask what's next, talk through a hard day, or send a voice note. Answers come from your own plan, and Sukhi tells you when it doesn't know.
landing.f2Title: Honest about what a photo shows
landing.f2Body: Share a photo of your walk or your meal. Sukhi tells you what it can see and what a photo can't prove. Your own word always counts.
landing.f3Body: See your week at a glance, earn milestones, and set a personal reward. Missing a day never takes anything away.
landing.why1Body: If anything on your prescription is unclear, Sukhi asks you to check it. It never fills in a dose or a time on its own.
landing.why2Body: If you don't reply, we record “no reply”, not a miss. Your history stays honest and kind.
landing.why3Body: Private by default. Family see a weekly summary only if you invite them, and you can stop sharing instantly.
landing.why4Title: Made for everyday life in India
landing.why4Body: English, Hindi and Marathi — mixed is fine — with large text options and WhatsApp for days when an app feels like too much.
landing.safetyTitle: Clear about what Sukhi is, and what it isn't
landing.safetyBody: Sukhi supports a routine you have already agreed on. It doesn't diagnose, change doses, or replace your doctor.
landing.safetyIs1: A friendly reminder and check-in companion
landing.safetyIs2: A record of your routine that you share on your terms
landing.safetyIs3: A place to note questions for your next appointment
landing.safetyIsnt1: A medical device or an emergency service
landing.safetyIsnt2: A source of medicine changes or catch-up doses
landing.safetyIsnt3: A substitute for help — worrying symptoms are pointed straight to real care
landing.familyTitle: Family can cheer you on, on your terms
landing.familyBody: Invite a son, daughter or friend to see how your week went. They see participation only — never your chats, documents or medicines. Stop sharing whenever you want.
landing.q1: Do I need to download an app?
landing.a1: No. Sukhi works in your phone's browser and can be added to your home screen. You can also use it on WhatsApp once it's connected.
landing.a2: No. Sukhi helps you follow the plan your care team gave you. Questions about doses or symptoms always go to your doctor or pharmacist.
landing.a3: English, Hindi and Marathi, including a mix of them. You can change the language any time in Settings.
landing.a4: Only you. Your plan, messages and photos are private. If you invite family, they see a weekly summary and nothing more.
landing.q5: What happens if I miss a day?
landing.a5: Nothing is lost. Missed days never reduce your progress, and the next time you check in, Sukhi welcomes you back.
landing.ctaTitle: Start with one small step today
landing.ctaBody: Set up your plan in a few minutes. Sukhi takes care of the reminders.
landing.footerTagline: A gentle companion for the routine you agreed on.
landing.copyright: © {year} Sukhi. Not a medical device. In an emergency, call 112.
landing.waTitle: Prefer WhatsApp? Sukhi is there too
landing.waBody: Get reminders where you already chat, and reply with a word, a photo or a voice note. Everything stays in sync with the app.
landing.waNote: Available once you connect your WhatsApp in Settings.

legal.draftNote: Pilot version, last updated 11 November 2026. This summary is under legal review.
legal.privacyIntro: Sukhi exists to help you keep a routine. We collect only what that needs, and you stay in control of it.
legal.pCollectBody: Your account email, the preferences you set, your plan, your check-ins, notes, photos and voice-note transcripts, and the messages you exchange with Sukhi.
legal.pUseBody: To schedule reminders, answer your questions from your own plan, show your progress, and keep an honest history. We don't sell your information or use it for advertising.
legal.pProcessorsBody: Supabase stores your data. If you allow it, Anthropic helps the assistant and photo descriptions, and our speech provider (ElevenLabs) turns voice notes into text and reads replies aloud. If you connect WhatsApp, Meta delivers those messages.
legal.pFamilyBody: Nothing is shared unless you invite someone. Invited family see weekly participation counts only, and you can stop sharing at any time.
legal.pChoicesBody: Turn AI, voice, reminders, WhatsApp and family sharing on or off in Settings. You can delete your account and all its data from Settings at any time.
legal.termsIntro: By using Sukhi you agree to these terms.
legal.tWhatBody: Sukhi is a companion that helps you follow a routine you have agreed on with your care team or set for yourself. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.
legal.tCareBody: Always follow your doctor's instructions. Never change, skip or double medicines because of something in Sukhi. In an emergency, call 112 or your local emergency number.
legal.tAccountBody: Keep your login details private. Only enter information about yourself, or about someone who has asked you to help them.
legal.tUseBody: Don't misuse the service, try to access other people's information, or send harmful content.
legal.tChangesBody: Sukhi may change as we learn. We will tell you about important changes in the app.
